title: The Dark Troopers Arrive!
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: As Grogu concentrates on reaching out for a connection in the Force, Moff Gideon launches an attack from orbit. Sending Dark Trooper Droids to Tython's surface, these Droid soldiers snatch Grogu before the Mandalorian can intercede. They bring Grogu to Moff Gideon for use in his heinous schemes!
